work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent DCXXXIII 95241, actual synopsis 95248–95253 and addressee/self-protocol 95255–95264 precede the act. Exclude floating transumpt marginal label 95244–95245, which corresponds to the preceding act's transumpt clause 95219–95226. The earlier Urbanus letter is expressly introduced as tenor at 95266–95274; its protocol 95278–95287 and body close with dating 95479–95481, before the enclosing act resumes at §2 95483. Ordered §§2–7 then end in dating 95719–95723; next DCXXXIV 95726. Historical notes through 95519–95521 remain. Contained quotation is not a new independent act; no body reversal found.
